An '''ice planet''' served as the corporate base of a [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist|wealthy industralist]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and was visited by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
